entities.summary: Florence Diya Aya is a Nigerian Politician and businesswoman. She was born in Garkida in 1948 and is from Garaje Agban, Kagoro, Kaura Local Government Area of Kaduna State. She was a member of the Kaduna State House of Assembly from 1990 to 1993.
